appointments.topic: A cough that won't go away
messages: Hi Lena, I've had a dry cough for about two weeks now. Worse at night. Anything I should do before we talk?
Hi Ava, thanks for the details. Nothing to take for now. If you can, note when it gets worse and whether you have a temperature. See you at the visit.
Looking forward to it. Mostly about not switching off in the evenings.

appointments.topic: Reading my new lease before I sign
messages: I'll send the lease here before the visit. The part about repairs worries me.
Perfect, send it whenever it suits you. I'll read it before we meet.

appointments.topic: A sore knee after long runs

messages: Should I bring the receipts for the roaster I bought?
Thanks again, the lunch plan is working.
appointments.notes:
Ava skips breakfast and lunch on busy days, then eats late.

We agreed on:
- a breakfast Ava can make in five minutes (oats, yoghurt, fruit)
- one prepared lunch for the two longest days
- water within reach at the desk

Check in again in three weeks.
